There is a 6 passenger maximum capacity. A private charter trip is perfect to create an intimate experience with friends, family, or a photography/videography-focused trip. These trips are also perfect for those who wish to fly their own drones from the boat. Private Charter Trips vary from half-day trips (up to 3 hours) to all-day trips (up to 6 hours).
